channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Potbelly: Week of Perks: BOGO 50% Off Entrees and a New Deal Every Day Through October 2
item.guid: Potbelly-Week of Perks: BOGO 50% Off Entrees and -2026-10-02
item.description: Potbelly's fifth annual Week of Perks runs September 28 to October 2: a different deal each day for Potbelly Perks members (free account required), announced in the app each morning, including buy-one-get-one 50% off entrees. Order in the app, on potbelly.com, or scan your Perks account in shop. (Select states only) (Through October 2, 2026)

item.title: Rubio's Coastal Grill: $7+ Meal Menu
item.description: Meals from $7 to $10 including the Fish and Chips at $7.99, available every day at participating locations. (CA, AZ & NV only) (Ongoing)

item.title: El Pollo Loco: $5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value Menu
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-$5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value M-2026-10-02
item.description: A rotating lineup of roughly $5 combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, taquitos and more) built on citrus-marinated fire-grilled chicken, every day at participating locations. Lineup and pricing vary by market. (West & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Safeway: $5 Friday: Fresh Sushi Rolls for $5
item.guid: Safeway-$5 Friday: Fresh Sushi Rolls for $5-2026-10-02
item.description: Every Friday, Safeway's $5 Friday lineup includes fresh sushi rolls from the in-store counter for $5 (regularly $8 to $10), alongside other prepared-food deals like an 8-piece chicken bag. Check the weekly ad for your division; a free Safeway for U account may be needed for the promo price. (Select states only) (Fridays only)

item.title: Harris Teeter: $6 Sushi Friday: California, Vegetable, Spicy Tuna and Spicy Salmon Rolls
item.guid: Harris Teeter-$6 Sushi Friday: California, Vegetable, -2026-10-02
item.description: Every Friday, Harris Teeter's Zenshi sushi counters sell four rolls for $6 each: California, Vegetable, Spicy Tuna and Spicy Salmon (regularly about $9.49 to $10.49). In store, while supplies last; the free VIC card may be needed for the promo price. Seen in store October 2, 2026. (Southeast & Mid-Atlantic only) (Fridays only)

item.title: Naf Naf Grill: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
item.guid: Naf Naf Grill-$9.99 Pita Meal Deal-2026-10-02
item.description: Get a stuffed pita (shawarma or falafel), a side, and a fountain drink for $9.99 nationwide at participating locations. (Midwest & East only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Salad and Go: Salads and wraps from $7
item.guid: Salad and Go-Salads and wraps from $7-2026-10-02
item.description: Everyday drive-thru menu of salads, wraps and grain bowls priced from about $7, no app or rewards card needed. (Southwest & South only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Publix: Sub of the Week: $2 off a whole sub
item.guid: Publix-Sub of the Week: $2 off a whole sub-2026-10-02
item.description: This week's featured Boar's Head deli sub is $2 off whole size at the Publix deli, changes weekly. (FL & Southeast only) (This week)

item.title: WaBa Grill: Value-Bowl Combo: mini bowl, side and drink for $7.99
item.guid: WaBa Grill-Value-Bowl Combo: mini bowl, side and dr-2026-10-02
item.description: A permanent value item: a mini bowl with chicken, sweet and spicy chicken or tofu, plus a value side and a 12 oz drink for $7.99, every day at participating locations. (CA & AZ only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Hy-Vee: Sushi Friday: Buy One Nori Roll, Get One 50% Off
item.guid: Hy-Vee-Sushi Friday: Buy One Nori Roll, Get One-2026-10-02
item.description: Every Friday at participating Hy-Vee stores, buy one regular Nori Sushi roll and get a second at half price. Store-run promotion: participation varies, no card or app needed. (Midwest only) (Fridays only)

item.title: Smoothie King: Free Upsize Friday: 32 oz Smoothie for the Price of a 20 oz
item.guid: Smoothie King-Free Upsize Friday: 32 oz Smoothie for t-2026-10-02
item.description: Every Friday, Healthy Rewards members (free account required) get a 32 oz smoothie for the price of a 20 oz when they order in the Smoothie King app, at participating locations. Rewards cannot be redeemed on these orders. (Fridays only)
